data.desc: First Capital, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCAP) is the holding company of First Harrison Bank , a community bank headquartered in Corydon, Indiana . First Harrison Bank operates 12 branches across Clark , Floyd , Harrison and Washington counties in Indiana , and 5 branches in Bullitt County, Kentucky . As of September 30, 2026 , First Capital had total assets of $1.3 billion , gross loans of $686 million and total deposits of $1.1 billion .
